_docs: Operations Rulebook — THE LAW of the GadgetGeeks Marketing Org. Every agent, every workflow, every approval MUST follow these rules. No exceptions.

rule_1_queue_item_format.description: Every queue item MUST have these fields. If any field is missing, the item is INVALID and must be rejected by the system.

required_fields.type: One of the allowed types listed in rule_2
required_fields.summary: Human-readable 1-line description of what this item does
required_fields.action_on_approve: Exactly what happens when the boss approves this. Must be a concrete action, not 'logged for reference'.

banned: Queue items with generic type like 'dialer' — must be specific (dialer_call, dialer_data_request)
Queue items with no 'action_on_approve' — if approval does nothing, don't queue it
Duplicate IDs in the same queue

rule_2_allowed_types_and_actions.description: Every queue item type maps to EXACTLY ONE action. No dead ends. If you approve it, something happens.

blog_publish.action: Generate header image via Gemini → Upload to Shopify CDN → Publish article via articleCreate → Send confirmation with live URL
blog_publish.confirmation: Telegram message with clickable live URL

seo_recommendation.action: Apply meta title/description to the target page via Shopify GraphQL metafield update
seo_recommendation.confirmation: Telegram message confirming which page was updated + link to verify

seo_content_brief.action: Move brief into blog-pipeline.json as a new blog entry with status 'brief_ready' → SCRIBE picks it up next scheduled run
seo_content_brief.confirmation: Telegram message: 'Brief queued for SCRIBE. Next write: [date]'

social_reply.action: Post reply via X API (or Postiz when available)
social_reply.confirmation: Telegram message with link to the posted reply

email_campaign.action: Send email via Resend API to the specified segment
email_campaign.confirmation: Telegram message with send count + campaign ID
email_campaign.rollback: Cannot unsend — this is why email requires explicit approval

dialer_call.action: Execute call via Vapi.ai to the specified phone number
dialer_call.confirmation: Telegram message with call status + duration
dialer_call.rollback: Cannot uncall — this is why calls require explicit approval

dialer_data_request.action: Fetch requested data from Shopify API and build call list → save to departments/dialer/call-list.json
dialer_data_request.confirmation: Telegram message with count of leads found per category

image_prompt.action: Generate image via Gemini Imagen and upload to Shopify Files
image_prompt.confirmation: Telegram message with image preview URL

canva_design.action: Create branded social media post in Canva using generated image + text overlays + brand kit → export as PNG
canva_design.confirmation: Telegram message with design preview + edit URL

rule_3_blog_pipeline_flow.description: The blog pipeline has EXACTLY these stages. No skipping. No self-grading. No shortcuts.

stages.who: SEO agent or content agent creates the brief
stages.next: SCRIBE picks up on next scheduled run (Mon/Wed/Fri 9:30 UTC)
Queued for boss approval via Telegram
Auto-publish: image generation → Shopify upload → article creation → confirmation

rules: SCRIBE NEVER grades its own work. Scanner + QUILL are the ONLY judges.
Scanner runs BEFORE QUILL. If scanner says BLOCKED, QUILL doesn't run.
No blog publishes without a header image. Image failure = publication blocked.
Every link in blog content MUST exist in store-inventory.json. Check 26 blocks unknown links.
Blog body MUST pass all 25 copy checks. BLOCKED = rewrite, not override.
Published URL uses gadgetgeekspro.com (custom domain), not .myshopify.com

rule_4_link_validation.description: Every internal link in ANY content (blogs, emails, social) MUST be validated before publishing.
rules: Only link to handles that exist in store-inventory.json products, collections, or pages
Use the canonical handle from store-inventory.json, not aliases
If a handle doesn't exist, DO NOT fabricate one. Remove the link or link to the closest valid alternative.
Pages that don't exist (/pages/warranty, /pages/grading-guide, /pages/our-inspection-process) MUST NOT be linked. Use /pages/return-policy or /pages/why-us instead.
copy_audit.py Check 26 enforces this automatically for blogs. Other content types must validate manually.
rule_4_link_validation.update_frequency: store-inventory.json must be refreshed weekly or whenever products are added/removed

rule_5_copy_quality.description: ALL customer-facing copy MUST pass the 25-check anti-AI scanner. No exceptions.

ratings.NEEDS_WORK: 1-2 critical — rewrite required, do NOT ship
ratings.BLOCKED: 3+ critical — full rewrite, investigate why agent produced this

rule_6_telegram_notifications.description: Every significant system action MUST notify the boss via Telegram. No silent operations.
required_notifications: Blog published → title + live URL + image confirmation
Blog blocked → reason + which checks failed + what agent needs to fix
Image generation failed → error message + 'publication blocked'
SEO change applied → which page + what changed + link to verify
Email sent → campaign name + send count + subject line used
Call completed → customer name + duration + outcome
Approval executed → WHAT was approved + WHAT action was taken + HOW to verify
Approval failed → WHAT failed + WHY + what to do next
rule_6_telegram_notifications.format: Every notification must include: (1) Status emoji, (2) Action type in bold, (3) What happened, (4) Clickable link to verify (if applicable)
banned: Silent approvals — if /approve does nothing visible, the system is broken

rule_7_incident_logging.description: Every failure, every bug, every 'that shouldn't have happened' gets logged to state/incident-log.json.
when_to_log: Copy scanner rates content as BLOCKED
Any agent produces output that violates the rules in this file
rule_7_incident_logging.review: GM reads incident-log.json every Friday in the weekly report. All agents load it before running.

rule_8_no_dead_ends.description: If the system queues something for approval, approving it MUST do something. Period.
rules: Before adding an item to queue.json, the creating agent MUST verify that the 'type' field matches one of the types in rule_2
If a type has no automation wired up yet, DO NOT queue it. Log it as a recommendation in the department's output file instead.
Every /approve MUST result in: (1) an action, (2) a confirmation, (3) a way to verify
If /approve results in 'Approved: [summary]' with no follow-up action, that is an INCIDENT (rule_7)

rule_9_one_store.description: There is ONE store. Only one. Forever.
rules: NEVER reference deviceplug.myshopify.com for anything
Published URLs use gadgetgeekspro.com (custom domain)
API calls go to gadgetgeekspro.myshopify.com/admin/api/2026-01/graphql.json
All product links are relative (/products/handle) so they work on any domain

rule_10_agent_independence.description: No agent grades its own work. Ever.
rules: SCRIBE writes blogs → copy_audit.py + QUILL grades them
LENS creates image prompts → FOCUS grades them
Content agent creates briefs → SEO agent validates keywords
If an agent self-reports 'GOOD' or 'EXCELLENT', that rating is IGNORED. Only the independent reviewer's rating counts.
Any agent caught self-grading gets an incident logged (rule_7)

rule_11_image_is_mandatory.description: EVERY blog MUST have a header image. No exceptions. No publishing without an image. EVER.

architectural_enforcement.primary_path: _auto_publish_blog() in telegram_bot.py generates image BEFORE publishing. If image generation fails, publication is BLOCKED.
architectural_enforcement.safety_net: /fix_image <handle> command retroactively generates and attaches an image to any published blog missing one.
architectural_enforcement.daily_check: image-generate.yml runs daily at 8:55 UTC. Checks all blog and social image prompts.
architectural_enforcement.pipeline_gate: Blog status cannot move from 'approved' to 'published' unless image generation succeeds.

rules: Blog publication code MUST call generate_blog_header() before articleCreate. No skipping.
If image generation fails, status = 'publish_blocked', NOT 'published'.
If a blog is discovered live without an image, trigger /fix_image immediately.
NEVER publish a blog via direct GraphQL articleCreate outside of _auto_publish_blog(). All publication goes through the pipeline.
The GEMINI_API_KEY must be available in any workflow that publishes blogs.
Image generation happens in GitHub Actions (where API keys live), never locally.
rule_11_image_is_mandatory.incident_reference: INC-005, INC-007 — blogs published without header images

rule_12_all_workflows_daily.description: All pipelines run daily. Image pipeline produces 10 images/day. Canva produces 10 designs/day. Blog pipeline produces 1 blog/day.

schedule.Image generation: Daily 8:55 UTC — generates images via Gemini Imagen
schedule.CANVAS (canva-post): Daily 9:25 UTC — creates 10 branded Canva designs from generated images
schedule.Social morning: Daily 9:45 UTC — picks up Canva designs and posts to platforms
schedule.SCRIBE (blog-writer): Daily 9:30 UTC — writes one blog from brief_ready queue
schedule.QUILL (blog-qa): Daily 10:00 UTC — scans and QA-reviews draft_ready blogs
schedule.PRESS (blog-publish): Daily 10:30 UTC — packages qa_approved blogs for approval

rules: The pipeline processes ONE blog per day through each stage
If no briefs are available, SCRIBE does nothing (no fabricating topics)
Each stage hands off to the next — no skipping stages
